firstWeek.heading: Week 1: complete your bio-data
firstWeek.body: Your first onboarding priority is to finish My profile. This gives HR the details needed before you move deeply into policies, documents, and checkpoints.
firstWeek.profile: Fill in your personal, contact, employment, and family information.
firstWeek.welcome: Add your National ID, NSSF, TIN, NHIF, and any statutory details you already have.
firstWeek.people: Complete banking or mobile-money details so payroll setup can begin.
firstWeek.policies: Attach qualification certificates and your current CV where requested.

pacing.heading: Your pace
pacing.onTrack: On track — you're keeping a steady pace. Keep it up!
pacing.behind: A little behind — aim to finish a section or two this week to catch up.
